title: Peacekeeper Operational Directive 01 — Enforcement of the Capitol Civic Code
summary: Establishes Peacekeeper enforcement doctrine, authority, and operational procedures for maintaining order and ensuring compliance with the Capitol Civic Code across all Districts.
text: All Peacekeeper personnel shall act in accordance with central command directives and preserve order through the enforcement of the Capitol Civic Code (CA-001). Peacekeepers are the primary enforcement authority within the Districts and are responsible for maintaining stability, ensuring compliance, and safeguarding Capitol interests at all times.

history.note: Initial issue of Peacekeeper Operational Directive 01.
Updated directive language and formalised enforcement doctrine under the Capitol Civic Code.

sections.heading: Operational Foreword
sections.text: This Directive establishes the operational framework for Peacekeeper forces across all Districts. It provides authority, structure, and enforcement guidance required to implement the Capitol Civic Code (CA-001). Peacekeepers represent the authority of the Capitol and must ensure absolute compliance, stability, and continuity of operations.

sections.heading: Section I — Authority of Enforcement
sections.text: Peacekeepers are authorised representatives of the Capitol with full authority to enforce all provisions of the Capitol Civic Code (CA-001). All lawful orders issued by Peacekeepers are binding and must be obeyed immediately.

sections.heading: Section II — Compliance Enforcement
sections.text: Peacekeepers shall identify and address all forms of non-compliance. Enforcement actions may include instruction, warning, restriction, detention, or corrective assignment. Escalation must ensure rapid restoration of order.

sections.heading: Section III — Public Order & Assembly Control
sections.text: Peacekeepers are responsible for maintaining public order. Unauthorised gatherings or disruptive behaviour may be dispersed. Controlled zones and enforcement formations may be deployed as required.

sections.heading: Section IV — Movement Regulation
sections.text: Peacekeepers shall enforce all movement controls under the Capitol Civic Code (CA-001). Individuals may be stopped, redirected, or denied movement where necessary. Checkpoints and inspections are authorised at all times.

sections.heading: Section V — Inspection & Verification
sections.text: Peacekeepers may conduct inspections of individuals, property, and workplaces to verify compliance. Refusal to cooperate constitutes non-compliance and may result in immediate enforcement action.

sections.heading: Section VI — Protection of Infrastructure & Production
sections.text: Peacekeepers shall ensure the protection of infrastructure and enforcement of production requirements. Any disruption to output or logistics may be subject to immediate intervention.

sections.heading: Section VII — Information Control Enforcement
sections.text: Peacekeepers shall enforce restrictions on unauthorised communications and materials as defined under the Capitol Civic Code (CA-001). Prohibited materials may be seized and investigated.

sections.heading: Section VIII — Civic Participation Enforcement
sections.text: Peacekeepers shall enforce attendance and participation in mandatory civic activities. Non-compliance may result in corrective action.

sections.heading: Section IX — Emergency Powers
sections.text: During periods of unrest or instability, Peacekeepers are authorised to implement emergency measures including curfews, lockdowns, and detentions to restore order.

sections.heading: Section X — Detention & Corrective Measures
sections.text: Peacekeepers may detain individuals for non-compliance or threat prevention. All detentions must follow Capitol administrative procedures and be formally recorded.

sections.heading: Section XI — Command & Reporting
sections.text: All Peacekeeper actions must be reported through the established chain of command. Directive compliance is mandatory and subject to oversight.

sections.heading: Section XII — Compliance Obligation
sections.text: All citizens are required to comply with Peacekeeper instructions. Failure to do so constitutes a breach of the Capitol Civic Code (CA-001) and will result in enforcement action.

sections.heading: Closing Directive Statement
sections.text: Peacekeepers are the enforcement arm of the Capitol. Through discipline, authority, and unwavering execution of duty, order is preserved. Compliance is mandatory. Stability is absolute.

title: Curfew Silence Enforcement Order
authority: Capitol Civic Code for District Administration and Citizen Conduct
summary: A Peacekeeper Operational Order establishing mandatory curfew silence requirements, restricted nighttime activity controls, and public conduct regulations during designated curfew periods in order to preserve public order, strengthen Peacekeeper operational authority, and support national security enforcement throughout Panem.

penalties.minorViolation: Verbal warning, curfew citation, or temporary detention for identity verification.
penalties.moderateViolation: Ration restrictions, mandatory compliance review, or enforced curfew supervision.
penalties.severeViolation: Arrest, detainment, or prosecution under applicable public order or State Security legislation.

crossReferences.label: Capitol Civic Code for District Administration and Citizen Conduct
Capitol Secrets and State Security Act

history.note: Initial issuance of the Curfew Silence Enforcement Order.

sections.heading: Short Title
sections.text: This Order may be cited as the Curfew Silence Enforcement Order.

sections.heading: Purpose and Security Objectives
sections.text: The purpose of this Order is to establish controlled nighttime security conditions, preserve public order during curfew periods, reduce unlawful assembly risks, support Peacekeeper operational effectiveness, and reinforce visible Capitol authority throughout Panem.

sections.heading: Definitions
sections.text: For the purposes of this Order, 'Curfew Period' shall mean any officially designated period of restricted civilian movement or activity authorised by the Capitol or Peacekeeper High Command. 'Restricted Noise Activity' shall include shouting, amplified sound, unauthorised music, public disturbances, industrial noise exceeding authorised limits, or any conduct deemed disruptive to public order enforcement operations.

sections.heading: Mandatory Curfew Compliance
sections.text: All citizens shall remain within authorised residential premises or approved operational locations during designated Curfew Periods unless specifically exempted by military authority, emergency necessity, employment authorisation, or official movement clearance.

sections.heading: Silence Enforcement Requirements
sections.text: During Curfew Periods, citizens shall maintain quiet and orderly conduct. Restricted Noise Activity within public streets, residential sectors, transportation routes, industrial compounds, or state-controlled facilities shall be prohibited unless expressly authorised by Peacekeeper command authority.

sections.heading: Public Street Restrictions
sections.text: No individual or group shall loiter, gather, assemble, travel without authorisation, or remain present within public streets, alleyways, transportation corridors, rail terminals, or designated security zones during Curfew Periods.

sections.heading: Lighting and Visibility Controls
sections.text: District authorities and residential occupants may be directed to comply with mandatory lighting restrictions, blackout directives, or visibility reduction measures during designated security operations or emergency enforcement conditions.

sections.heading: Peacekeeper Authority During Curfew Operations
sections.text: Peacekeeper personnel shall possess authority to stop, question, detain, search, identify, disperse, or remove individuals suspected of violating this Order or otherwise interfering with nighttime public order operations.

sections.heading: Operational Broadcast Compliance
sections.text: Citizens shall comply immediately with all curfew sirens, public security announcements, emergency broadcasts, loudspeaker instructions, or operational directives issued during Curfew Periods.

sections.heading: Suspicious Activity Reporting Obligations
sections.text: Citizens possessing knowledge of unauthorised movement, illegal gatherings, curfew violations, sabotage activity, or suspicious nighttime conduct shall report such information to the appropriate authorities without unreasonable delay.

sections.heading: Inspection and Enforcement Operations
sections.text: The Peacekeeper Authority and authorised State Security personnel may establish checkpoints, conduct patrol operations, enforce movement controls, verify identification, inspect premises, and implement temporary operational security zones for the purposes of enforcing this Order.

sections.heading: Enforcement and Penalties
sections.text: Violations of this Order may result in curfew sanctions, detention, ration restrictions, compulsory civic compliance review, arrest, or prosecution under applicable Capitol and State Security legislation depending upon the severity, intent, and operational impact of the violation.

sections.heading: Emergency Security Escalation
sections.text: During periods of civil unrest, insurrection risk, sabotage operations, wartime conditions, or declared emergency status, Peacekeeper High Command may impose enhanced curfew measures, extended silence enforcement periods, movement prohibitions, or district-wide lockdown directives.

sections.heading: Commencement
sections.text: This Order shall enter into force immediately upon authorisation by Peacekeeper High Command.

title: Peacekeeper Eye Contact Restriction
authority: Capitol Civic Code for District Administration and Citizen Conduct
summary: A Peacekeeper Operational Order establishing mandatory civilian conduct standards during interactions with Peacekeeper personnel in order to preserve operational authority, maintain public order, reinforce lawful command presence, and reduce hostile or disruptive conduct toward authorised security personnel throughout Panem.

penalties.minorViolation: Verbal warning, public conduct citation, or temporary detention for identification verification.
penalties.moderateViolation: Ration restrictions, compulsory civic compliance instruction, or formal loyalty review.
penalties.severeViolation: Arrest, detainment, or prosecution under applicable public order and State Security legislation.

crossReferences.label: Capitol Civic Code for District Administration and Citizen Conduct
Capitol Secrets and State Security Act

history.note: Initial issuance of the Peacekeeper Eye Contact Restriction.

sections.heading: Short Title
sections.text: This Order may be cited as the Peacekeeper Eye Contact Restriction.

sections.heading: Purpose and Operational Objectives
sections.text: The purpose of this Order is to establish controlled standards of civilian interaction with Peacekeeper personnel, reinforce operational authority, reduce confrontational behaviour, support public order enforcement, and preserve visible respect toward authorised security forces throughout Panem.

sections.heading: Definitions
sections.text: For the purposes of this Order, 'Restricted Conduct' shall mean any behaviour reasonably interpreted as hostile, confrontational, obstructive, intimidating, disrespectful, or disruptive toward authorised Peacekeeper personnel. 'Direct Confrontational Eye Contact' shall mean prolonged or aggressive visual engagement reasonably interpreted by Peacekeeper personnel as threatening, provocative, or resistant to lawful authority.

sections.heading: Mandatory Civilian Conduct Standards
sections.text: All civilians interacting with Peacekeeper personnel shall conduct themselves in a respectful, orderly, compliant, and non-confrontational manner at all times.

sections.heading: Restriction on Confrontational Behaviour
sections.text: No civilian shall engage in Direct Confrontational Eye Contact, aggressive gestures, obstructive movement, hostile posture, verbal intimidation, unauthorised recording activity, or conduct reasonably interpreted as interference with Peacekeeper authority or operational duties.

sections.heading: Compliance During Inspections and Encounters
sections.text: Citizens subjected to inspections, questioning, checkpoint procedures, identity verification, or lawful Peacekeeper instruction shall remain stationary when directed, maintain visible hands when requested, and comply immediately with all authorised commands.

sections.heading: Public Passage and Operational Priority
sections.text: Civilians shall yield unobstructed passage to Peacekeeper patrols, emergency response units, security convoys, and authorised operational personnel engaged in official duties.

sections.heading: Authority to Intervene and Detain
sections.text: Peacekeeper personnel may stop, question, search, identify, disperse, or temporarily detain individuals reasonably suspected of violating this Order or otherwise interfering with public order or operational security.

sections.heading: Enhanced Enforcement During Security Operations
sections.text: During periods of civil unrest, insurrection risk, emergency enforcement operations, wartime conditions, or elevated State Security threat levels, Peacekeeper High Command may impose enhanced civilian conduct controls and expanded enforcement measures under this Order.

sections.heading: Educational and Civic Instruction
sections.text: Educational institutions, workplaces, transportation authorities, and District administrations may provide mandatory civic instruction concerning lawful interaction standards, Peacekeeper authority, and civilian compliance obligations established under this Order.

sections.heading: Mandatory Reporting Obligations
sections.text: Citizens possessing knowledge of hostile conduct toward Peacekeeper personnel, organised resistance activity, or repeated violations of this Order shall report such information to the appropriate authorities without unreasonable delay.

sections.heading: Inspection and Enforcement Authority
sections.text: The Peacekeeper Authority and authorised Panem State Security representatives shall possess authority to enforce this Order, conduct investigations, issue compliance directives, review incident reports, and implement operational measures necessary for the preservation of public order.

sections.heading: Enforcement and Penalties
sections.text: Violations of this Order may result in public conduct sanctions, detention, ration restrictions, compulsory ideological instruction, civic penalties, arrest, or prosecution under applicable Capitol and State Security legislation depending upon the severity, intent, and operational impact of the offence.

sections.heading: Regulatory Authority
sections.text: Peacekeeper High Command may issue supplemental directives, civilian conduct standards, checkpoint procedures, inspection guidance, and operational enforcement regulations necessary for the implementation and administration of this Order.

sections.heading: Commencement
sections.text: This Order shall enter into force immediately upon authorisation by Peacekeeper High Command.
